alert.text: {"alert_card":{"title":"3 號機蒸汽壓下降","summary":"3 號硫化機蒸汽壓 4.8 → 3.9 kgf/cm²，溫度 126°C 仍在範圍內（小胎）"},"goal":"3 號蒸汽壓下降，小胎不延誤","hypothesis":{"id":"H1","statement":"蒸汽壓不足，溫度會穩定","cause_code":"steam_pressure_low","expectation":{"machine_id":"CURE-03","channel":"steam_kgf_cm2","op":"<=","value":4.5,"within_min":30.0},"status":"active","evidence":["30 分鐘溫度 126°C 不變","蒸汽壓 4.8 → 3.9 kgf/cm²"]},"rejected_hypothesis_ids":[],"steps":[{"id":"S1","tool":"cure_formula","args":{"size":"S","ref_temp_c":128.0,"actual_temp_c":126.0,"elapsed_h":6.0,"ref_cure_h":24.0,"activation_energy_kj_mol":85.0},"depends_on":[],"purpose":"以 Arrhenius 計算降溫後所需總硫化時間"},{"id":"S2","tool":"query_orders_shifts","args":{"press_ids":["CURE-03"]},"depends_on":[],"purpose":"查下一模訂單交期與班表缺口"},{"id":"S3","tool":"solve_schedule","args":{"cure_overrides_h":{"CURE-03":"$S1.total_cure_h"},"time_limit_s":10.0},"depends_on":["S1","S2"],"purpose":"延長硫化後重排，保小胎交期"},{"id":"S4","tool":"confirm_schedule","args":{"schedule_version":"$S3.schedule_version","reason":"3 號機蒸汽壓下降，延長硫化至 ${S1.total_cure_h} h 後重排"},"depends_on":["S3"],"purpose":"確認新排程（需主管核准）"},{"id":"S5","tool":"set_cure_time","args":{"press_id":"CURE-03","total_cure_h":"$S1.total_cure_h","reason":"3 號機蒸汽壓下降，Arrhenius 等效硫化"},"depends_on":["S1","S3"],"purpose":"設定3 號機硫化時間為公式值（需主管核准）"},{"id":"S6","tool":"notify_teams","args":{"teams":["curing","body"],"kind":"info","machine_id":"CURE-03","message":"3 號機延長硫化至 ${S1.total_cure_h} h（+${S1.extra_h} h），已依新排程調整下一模"},"depends_on":["S4","S5"],"purpose":"通知硫化組與夜班新排程"}],"safe_stop":false,"rationale":"溫度 126°C 在安全窗口，以 Arrhenius 公式延長硫化時間，再由求解器重排以保交期。"}
